integrity: Analytical universal proof with independently formed exact-rational matrix checks as supplementary verification. No assertion of exhaustive historical priority or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Directed cycles with at least four vertices and positive time-independent rates; the completed degree-two and degree-three Taylor/RK stability polynomials only. Sharp endpoint positivity bounds do not imply internal-stage positivity, superior accuracy, or nonlinear SSP guarantees.
title: A sharp 25%-loss/50%-gain law for RK3 versus RK2 positivity on directed Markov cycles
